negative_controls: wrong-data: independent debug readback data oracle
late_link_fault: retained terminal copy may be consumed; actual debug/fabric retirement blocked; sticky fault and busy until common cold reset
initial_failure: native-r1 reversed final testbench reset scheduling race; exact FAIL receipt/logs/source snapshots retained; no production change for correction
limitations: Full platform with DDR/network/fixed peripherals is elaborated, not dynamically simulated as a whole.
Native fixture uses real I1/loader/Atomic/Home and internal 1 MiB RAM.
No complete-system drain ACK or physical CDC/timing/gating/DRP qualification.
Short external IRQ during stopped fabric still needs fixed/source-domain capture or held-request contract.
Permanent owner nonresponse or active link loss may safely block forever; common reset required.
Remote publication remains blocked pending exact receipt approval; this stage is local only.
